title: neomolinia fauriei
intro: Neomolinia fauriei, commonly known as Fauriei's Molinia, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the grass family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, and its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Neomolinia fauriei include its use as a diuretic and in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
